title: Cadmies Graphical Interface
definition: A graphical user interface for the CADMIES-IPLD system, allowing users to interact with and navigate the system locally and air-gapped.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine your computer system as a garden. The CADMIES Graphical Interface is like a map you can use to explore and manage this garden. It helps you add new ideas, find existing ones, and see how they're connected.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES Graphical Interface is a software application that provides a user-friendly way to interact with the CADMIES-IPLD system. It allows users to add new concepts, browse the concept library, view a knowledge graph, and access an audit trail of operations.
difficulty_levels.expert: The CADMIES Graphical Interface is a novel application of graph theory and human-computer interaction. It enables users to navigate and manipulate the CADMIES-IPLD system, which is a decentralized and self-verifying data structure. The interface's design highlights the interconnectedness of concepts and their relationships, providing a unique and intuitive user experience. This design also has implications for the field of knowledge representation, as it showcases the potential of graph-based systems for organizing and presenting complex information.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES Graphical Interface demonstrates the power of graph theory and human-computer interaction in creating a user-friendly and intuitive interface for navigating and manipulating a decentralized and self-verifying data structure.
